why_not_xgboost: XGBoost overfits sparse [0,1] binary features (same_feature, som_cache_hit, domain_class_match) via arbitrarily fine splits with zero support. Feedforward + BatchNorm learns smooth relevance manifolds over sparse inputs. SOM 20×20 cell embeddings are dense continuous signals unsuitable for tree splits. Policy framing extends naturally to GRPO reward shaping.
